Product Features

  • Total dimensions: TV cabinet 140 x 35 x 39 cm, wall cabinet 52 x 28 x 77 cm, wall shelf 78.5 x 13.5 x 8 cm. Ideal for small living rooms.
  • This wall cabinet set is the perfect addition to your living room, optimizing space without sacrificing style. The set consists of a wall cabinet, a presentation shelf and a TV cabinet, making it the ideal TV cabinet set for your living room.
  • The TV cabinet has a compartment and two semi-open dividers. The wall cabinet has a divider and a wall-mounted display shelf, providing ample space for multimedia devices, books, and various small items. It's also perfect for displaying decorative items, picture frames, and even potted plants.
  • The TV cabinet set is made of high-quality chipboard, giving it a modern look that matches any décor.
  • The cabinet doors have soft-close hinges for smooth opening and closing, ensuring durability. The high-quality chipboard has a load capacity of 40 kg and is durable and resistant to damage.
  • The contrasting color scheme of natural wood and black makes for a modern and stylish design that embodies innovation and design.
  • The smooth and easy-to-clean surface eliminates the hassle of cleaning and ensures a clean and tidy experience in your living room.
  • The rational structure design allows the whole TV cabinet set to be installed in staggered locations and blends seamlessly with the TV screen, creating a beautiful overall layout and comfortable feeling.
  • Functional integration: The integration of storage, presentation and decoration – from practical storage to beautiful presentation – increases the quality of living in your living room through design.
  • Note: This product comes in two packages and may arrive with a time delay. Please make sure both packages have been delivered before you start assembly.
